title: Free a sleeve held by a stopped wringer
instruction: Free the trapped sleeve and leave the sleeve and arm form on the near side of the wringer.
context: A pair of stopped squeeze rollers can still hold fabric attached to a person's wrist. Relieving pressure lets a rescuer withdraw the arm without loading the wrist.
setup: Use the fixed YAM station. The fixture centre is at station x=0.350 m, y=0 on the tabletop. A fixed 120 x 190 x 16 mm base carries a stationary lower roller and a spring-loaded upper roller, each 65 mm in diameter and 120 mm wide. The guided yellow crosshead has two opposing grip tabs. A blue 136 x 35 x 6 mm rigid test coupon starts with its centre 41 mm toward the operator from the roller centreline. An orange 50 x 44 x 27 mm dummy wrist sits a further 90 mm along the guide, joined to the coupon by a 350 N/m spring. The coupon and dummy have prismatic guides. Rubber-like contact surfaces, fixed base, rigid trainer parts and a horizontal draw along the x-axis are specified by the included USD. Both grippers start in the normal ready pose. The sleeve guide uses passive viscous drag of 1.0 N s/m capped at 0.25 N, with zero stiffness and zero velocity target. The 3 mm empty closing stop accommodates the 6 mm coupon. All fixture colliders use the rigid rubber-like contact model. Dimensions and reset coordinates are tabulated in README.md.
scoring: Score 0 if wrist traction ever reaches 5 N or the fixture or a guide violates the bounds in README.md. Otherwise award 0.25 for opening the gap to at least 9 mm with hand contact and advancing at least 10 mm of previously captured coupon with hand contact on the dummy while the gap is at least 9 mm. Award 1 for 45 mm of this guided travel, withdrawal of at least 75 mm, both far corners more than 34 mm past the nip, wrist centre more than 195 mm toward the operator, load below 1 N, and 0.5 continuous seconds with these conditions, no robot contact above 0.04 N and both speeds below 18 mm/s. Otherwise retain any earned partial credit or score 0. The force limits refer to the surrogate spring.
run_limit: 360 actions at 20 Hz (18 seconds of simulated control time).
reset_notes: Use the supplied compound USD on the fixed station and reset for each trial. The rollers start stopped. Confirm the coupon is captured and the wrist is near its 90 mm rest extension.
fidelity: The trainer models residual clamping with passive joints, contact friction, a calibrated nominal wrist spring and a guided rigid coupon. It omits fabric folding, tearing, powered rotation and soft-tissue biomechanics. A physically built trainer needs its own force calibration. Guide drag is a simulation design parameter and requires calibration for a physical carriage.
